main_text.l: Congregationi libenter concessi, ut
excerpto ab exemplari meo literarum spe-
cimine, ad ejus usum Germanus ille characteres
hosce Samaritanos, in quo nunc
laborat, excudat. Attamen mirum in
modum lætatus fui, quando R. Pater Ber-
tinus una cum Aleandro, nec non aman-
tissimus ille bonarum literarum de iisque
optime meritus Dominus de Peiresc, me
de R. Paternitate tua admonuerant, virum
nempe LingvarumOrientalium
studiosissimum æque ac peritissimum esse,
& propterea ad id onus suscipiendum
Pentateuchi Samaritani tum fideliter
interpretandi tum eximia diligentia inpri-
mendi, ante alios omnes longe idoneum
itemque paratissimum fore. Persvaden-
tibus idcirco, ut ad te librum in Gallias
amandarem, facile assensi; dummodo
enim publico consulatur commodo, ni-
hil ad me refert, an liber Parisiis, an
Romæ sit excusus: & quia hic nullum habebamus,
qui Samaritani idiomatis, nec pri-
ma quidem limina attingeret, & ab ho-
mine linguæ ignaro, qui literas tantum

page.notes: Printed "LingvarumOrientalium" has no space between the words; kept as printed. Scan is slightly blurred in places, but all lines were legible. Spelling "fui," and "tua admonuerant" kept as printed.
